The '''Langhesa system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Meram sector/Legends|Meram sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Langhesa]].
